description:
Get detailed information about ONE ICD-11 entity you already have a code or URI for.

Use this tool to:
- Get the full definition of a disease
- Retrieve coding notes, inclusions and exclusions
- Get the official title and index terms (synonyms)

Provide `code` (e.g., "BA00") or `uri` (any URI a previous answer returned) — at least one is required; calling with neither returns a validation error naming both. Set `language` for WHO's official translations (e.g. `language: "pt"` for official Portuguese).

Returns a single entity (no pagination). A code WHO does not know comes back as a "not found" error, never an empty record.

When NOT to use: to find a code from a disease name, use icd11_search first; to walk parents/children, use icd11_hierarchy; for an ICD-10 code (like "E11"), convert it with map_icd10_to_icd11 — ICD-10 codes are not ICD-11 codes.

language.description: Language code (default: en). Returns the source's OFFICIAL translation when it exists (e.g. 'pt' for official Portuguese); content is never machine-translated.

name: icd11_lookup

attribution.description: Canonical source URLs of this response (attribution list)

provenance.description: Provenance block: source, URL, data vintage, extraction instant, origin diagnostics, citation, license

data_vintage.description: Version/release of the data as exposed by the source; null when not exposed

derivation_note.description: What this server computed; present together with derived

derived.description: Present (true) only when this server computed the value (e.g. a ranking or summary statistics) instead of passing on what the source returned

field_sources.description: Present only when the response joins parts from different origins or extraction instants: for each group of fields, its URL, extraction instant and whether it came from cache. Absent in single-origin responses

items.description: Proveniência de um grupo de campos da resposta: de onde veio e quando foi extraído

fields.description: Campos do payload atribuídos a esta sub-fonte

retrieved_at.description: ISO-8601 da extração desta sub-fonte na origem

served_from_cache.description: true se esta sub-fonte veio do cache do servidor (retrieved_at é o da extração original); false se foi buscada nesta chamada; null se o servidor não distingue

source_url.description: URL canônica da sub-fonte que originou estes campos

license.description: License / legal regime of the data

notices.description: Notices the source publishes alongside the data (license statements, caveats), verbatim. Absent when there is none

anomalies.description: Anomalias superadas até o sucesso, somadas por classe, em ordem fixa; [] se nenhuma

kind.description: Classe da anomalia (vocabulário fechado do contrato)

attempts.description: Tentativas somadas, incluindo as repetidas (>= requests)

requests.description: Idas distintas à origem que compõem esta resposta (fatias, páginas)

unstable.description: true se houve repetição (attempts > requests) ou alguma anomalia

retrieval.description: Origin diagnostics of THIS source in this call: requests made to the upstream, attempts summed across retries, anomalies worked around (kind + count); unstable=true when any anomaly happened. null when nothing was measured (bundled dataset, or response served entirely from cache)

retrieved_at.description: Real instant of the upstream extraction (ISO-8601, UTC). Responses served from cache keep the ORIGINAL fetch instant.

revision.description: Whether the data can still change at the source: current = the version in force, the source may revise it; provisional = preliminary; final = will not change. Absent when unknown

note.description: O específico da fonte: o que revisa, quando, por quê

status.description: current = versão vigente, a fonte pode revisá-la; provisional = preliminar, incompleta ou sujeita a mudança (não compare como se fosse fechada); final = não muda mais, declarado pela fonte

source.description: Official upstream source of this data

source_url.description: Canonical URL of the source (API base or dataset release)

title: ICD-11 Entity Details
